TOUHOUANCIENTS-TOUHOUANCIENTREGENT.title: The Regent
TOUHOUANCIENTS-TOUHOUANCIENTREGENT.descr: His Majesty, who is heir to the Throne of Stars, hails from space. Thus, His Majesty is something of a Celestial.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-TOUHOUANCIENTFILTH.title: Impurity
TOUHOUANCIENTS-TOUHOUANCIENTFILTH.descri: Even with infinite rebirths and purification, Impurity inevitably accumulates. As Impurity builds up, the side effects of resurrection via the Ultramarine Orb Elixir grow stronger.
